subject.title: fix(oc-path): bound config file reads with size cap

question: Should `oc-path` impose a fixed 10 MiB maximum on all existing config-like files, or should the bounded-read implementation use a different compatibility-reviewed limit and error contract?
rationale: The underlying OOM safeguard is valid, but an unconditional new maximum can make previously accepted files fail at runtime; that product compatibility boundary is not established by the PR body or tests.

options.title: Adopt a documented compatibility-reviewed limit
options.body: Keep the bounded-read protection but have an owner confirm the maximum, error behavior, and upgrade expectation for existing larger files.

options.title: Pause the hard-cap change
options.body: Defer the limit until maintainers define the supported size contract for `oc-path` inputs.

recommendation.title: Adopt a documented compatibility-reviewed limit
recommendation.body: Keep the bounded-read protection but have an owner confirm the maximum, error behavior, and upgrade expectation for existing larger files.
